title: sequenceInputLayer
summary: Create a sequence input layer compatibility object.
description: `sequenceInputLayer(inputSize)` creates metadata for sequence network definitions.
behaviors: `inputSize` may be a positive integer scalar or numeric vector of positive integers.
Common name-value options are preserved as properties.

example.input:
layer = sequenceInputLayer(inputSize)
layer = sequenceInputLayer(inputSize, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work and has no provider kernel.
